cases.name: Clean host and exact archive
cases.oracle: Owner-declared blank host observed as Ubuntu 24.04 LTS/amd64/systemd, existing state reviewed; exact G11 archive and manifest hashes verified.
cases.required_evidence: host identity, original inventory, archive verification

cases.name: Mandatory preflight refusals
cases.oracle: Each of package/host/systemd/nginx/php/mysql/redis/storage/clamav refuses a distinct missing, wrong or unhealthy condition before migration/completion; other checks and restored nine-check baseline recorded.
cases.required_evidence: preflight matrix, authority before/after, refusal/recovery results

cases.name: Browser-to-root fresh installation
cases.oracle: Real HTTPS browser configuration, root approval and scheduled apply complete without state fixtures or manual code/database patches; empty DB receives immutable migration catalog.
cases.required_evidence: browser screenshots, redacted HTTP, root timeline, migration catalog

cases.name: Native runtime and storage
cases.oracle: Eight declared units enabled and active as nonroot, Nginx sole public business ingress, local-storage permissions correct, no Docker/Node runtime.
cases.required_evidence: unit properties, listener inventory, Nginx syntax, storage modes

cases.name: Completion and retirement
cases.oracle: Full health verified before root completion lock; Installer retired with matching authority and inaccessible public entry.
cases.required_evidence: completion authority, full health, HTTP lock and timer/pool status

cases.name: Eight-service restart
cases.oracle: All eight restarted with recorded new process identities and complete health/P0 recovery.
cases.required_evidence: before/after unit state and PID, full health/P0

cases.name: Whole-host reboot
cases.oracle: Same machine identity and different boot ID after actual reboot; all eight enabled/active and complete health/P0 pass without manual repairs.
cases.required_evidence: before/after boot identity, unit state, complete health/P0

cases.name: Nginx reload and revert
cases.oracle: Configuration test, atomic reload and failed-candidate revert preserve expected authority and restore ordinary TLS traffic.
cases.required_evidence: Nginx commands, config hashes, HTTP recovery

cases.name: MySQL backup and restore
cases.oracle: Real backup restored and schema/data compared, including necessary partial-DDL/missing-schema recovery.
cases.required_evidence: backup identity, restore rehearsal, data/schema comparisons

cases.name: Redis and risk recovery
cases.oracle: Dedicated test Redis flush/disconnect/reconnect and durable risk-cache rebuild restore data semantics without broad cleanup of unrelated state.
cases.required_evidence: DB/risk fixtures, Redis failure/recovery and health

cases.name: ClamAV and files
cases.oracle: Real healthy signatures/engine accept clean upload and reject EICAR; unavailable scanner prevents completion/unsafe publication.
cases.required_evidence: scanner health, clean/EICAR HTTP and storage results

cases.name: Upgrade and database-required rollback
cases.oracle: Identity-verified compatible candidate and rehearsed backups; failed upgrade and schema restoration recover configuration, data and eight-service/P0 health. Same-binary fixture limits remain explicit.
cases.required_evidence: candidate hashes, interruption/recovery timeline, restored DB/files/config, health/P0

cases.name: Real production providers and rollback
cases.oracle: Separately authorized owner-controlled production verifies real P0 user/admin/payment/mail/OAuth/Turnstile/domain/SEO and complete native upgrade/rollback; no test substitutes.
cases.required_evidence: redacted real-provider/production records, Search Console, rollback proof

cases.name: Accountable final decisions
cases.oracle: Platform Lead + QA review G12; Release Owner + Security Reviewer + Platform Lead review G13. Owner G11 delegation does not manufacture later approvals.
cases.required_evidence: attributed decisions, timestamps and exact evidence indices

supported_target: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS / linux amd64 / native systemd
